Jet-Ski Tours of Miami gives you the largest riding area in Miami Beach. Your speed zone starts seconds after leaving our dock, not 15 minutes into your ride time.

blurb: Guests take a 90-minute tour on a 40-ft. long, 49-passenger amphibious bus that travels on streets and Biscayne Bay. The tour includes entertaining narration with historical tidbits. The vehicle is USCG inspected and captains hold USCG Masters licenses and commercial driver's licenses.

quotes.author: Lorrainne S.
quotes.text: We booked this tour at the suggestion of friends and were not disappointed. Our tour guide, Richie, did an awesome job giving us Miami culture while making it fun. Lots of fun!

quotes.author: ctivnan
quotes.text: This was a great way to familiarize yourself with the area. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and had a great personality.
Great time with knowledgeable hosts. My wife and I had been on several of the Duck Tours in various cities we’ve visited and this one tops those!
The trip was great! Very unique to ride around town but then go in the water. Rick was very friendly and knowledgeable of the Miami area.
